userStories.title: Project folder selection via CLI argument
userStories.description: As a user, I want to specify a root folder as a command-line argument so that PRDMonitor knows where to look for prd.json files.
acceptanceCriteria: User can pass folder path as a CLI argument (e.g., prdmonitor /path/to/projects)
Application validates that the folder exists and is readable
Default to current directory if no argument provided
Error message printed to stderr if folder is invalid or inaccessible

userStories.title: Subdirectory scanning for prd.json files
userStories.description: As a user, I want the application to scan all subdirectories for prd.json files so that all my projects are discovered automatically.
acceptanceCriteria: Application recursively scans subdirectories of the selected folder
Only files named prd.json are detected
Scanning happens on application startup
Number of discovered projects is displayed in the TUI header

userStories.title: JSON parsing and validation
userStories.description: As a user, I want prd.json files to be parsed correctly so that user story data is available for display.
acceptanceCriteria: Valid JSON files are parsed without errors
Project name is extracted from the top-level name field
User stories array is extracted with id, title, description, and status
Malformed JSON files are handled gracefully with error logging

userStories.title: Terminal UI with Kanban board layout
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see a terminal-based Kanban board with Incomplete, In Progress, and Complete columns so that I can visualize status without leaving the terminal.
acceptanceCriteria: TUI displays three columns: Incomplete, In Progress, Complete
Columns are clearly labeled with distinct visual styling
Layout adapts to terminal width
Empty columns display a placeholder message
Uses a Go TUI library such as bubbletea or tview

userStories.title: User story card display
userStories.description: As a user, I want each user story displayed as a card showing the id, title, description, and project name so that I can quickly understand what each story is about.
acceptanceCriteria: Each card displays the user story id prominently
Card shows the title in bold or highlighted text
Description is displayed below the title (truncated if needed)
Project name from prd.json name field appears at the top of the card
Cards use box-drawing characters or borders for visual separation

userStories.title: Status-based card sorting
userStories.description: As a user, I want user stories automatically sorted into the correct column based on their status field so that the board accurately reflects project progress.
acceptanceCriteria: Stories with status incomplete appear in the Incomplete column
Stories with status in-progress appear in the In Progress column
Stories with status complete appear in the Complete column
Unknown status values default to the Incomplete column

userStories.title: File change detection and live updates
userStories.description: As a user, I want the board to automatically update when prd.json files are modified so that I always see the current state without restarting.
acceptanceCriteria: File system watcher monitors all discovered prd.json files using fsnotify
Changes to existing files trigger a re-parse and TUI refresh
Board updates within 2 seconds of file change
TUI remains responsive during file watching

userStories.title: New file detection
userStories.description: As a user, I want newly created prd.json files to be automatically discovered so that new projects appear on the board without restarting the application.
acceptanceCriteria: New prd.json files in existing subdirectories are detected
New subdirectories with prd.json files are detected
New projects appear on the board automatically
Detection occurs within 5 seconds of file creation

userStories.title: Read-only board interface
userStories.description: As a user, I want the board to be read-only so that changes can only be made by editing the prd.json files directly.
acceptanceCriteria: Cards cannot be moved or edited via keyboard or mouse
No edit commands are available in the TUI
Status bar indicates the board is view-only
Helpful message suggests editing prd.json files directly

userStories.title: File deletion handling
userStories.description: As a user, I want projects to be removed from the board when their prd.json file is deleted so that the board stays accurate.
acceptanceCriteria: Deleted prd.json files are detected by the file watcher
Associated project cards are removed from the board
Removal happens automatically without manual intervention
No orphaned cards remain after file deletion

userStories.title: Multi-project aggregation
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see user stories from all discovered projects on a single board so that I have a unified view of all work.
acceptanceCriteria: Cards from multiple prd.json files appear on the same board
Project name on each card distinguishes which project it belongs to
Cards are sorted by status regardless of source project
Board handles at least 20 projects without performance issues

userStories.title: Keyboard navigation
userStories.description: As a user, I want to navigate the board using keyboard shortcuts so that I can efficiently browse user stories.
acceptanceCriteria: Arrow keys or hjkl navigate between cards and columns
Enter or space expands a card to show full description
Tab cycles between columns
q or Ctrl+C quits the application
? displays a help overlay with available shortcuts

userStories.title: Scrollable columns
userStories.description: As a user, I want to scroll within columns when there are more cards than fit on screen so that I can view all user stories.
acceptanceCriteria: Columns are independently scrollable
Scroll position indicator shows current position
Scrolling works via keyboard navigation
Mouse scroll is supported if terminal allows

userStories.title: Graceful exit and cleanup
userStories.description: As a user, I want the application to exit cleanly and restore my terminal state so that my terminal is not left in a broken state.
acceptanceCriteria: Terminal state is restored on exit
File watchers are properly closed
Exit works via q key or Ctrl+C
No zombie processes or resource leaks

userStories.title: Add top padding to TUI
userStories.description: As a user, I want padding at the top of the TUI so that the content doesn't appear cramped against the top edge of the terminal.
acceptanceCriteria: There is visible spacing between the top of the terminal and the first row of content
Padding is consistent across different terminal sizes
Header or title area has appropriate breathing room

userStories.title: Add right-side padding to TUI
userStories.description: As a user, I want padding on the right side of the TUI so that the content doesn't touch the right edge of the terminal.
acceptanceCriteria: There is visible spacing between the rightmost column content and the terminal edge
Padding is consistent across different terminal sizes
Cards and column borders have appropriate margin from the right edge

userStories.title: Application crashes when scanning large directories
userStories.description: As a user, I want to be able to open PRDMonitor with a large folder like ~/Developer without the application crashing so that I can monitor all my projects.
acceptanceCriteria: Application handles large directory trees without crashing
Scanning ~/Developer or similar large folders works reliably
Errors during scanning are handled gracefully with informative messages
Application remains responsive while scanning many subdirectories

userStories.title: ASCII art title header
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see a stylish ASCII art title displaying 'PRDMonitor' at the top of the TUI so that the application has a distinctive and professional appearance.
acceptanceCriteria: ASCII art title 'PRDMonitor' is displayed at the top of the TUI
Title uses a visually appealing ASCII font style
Title is centered or appropriately positioned
Title does not interfere with the Kanban board layout below it
Title adapts or truncates gracefully on narrow terminals

userStories.title: Equal padding on all sides of columns
userStories.description: As a user, I want the padding around the Kanban columns to be equal on all sides so that the layout looks balanced and visually consistent.
acceptanceCriteria: Padding on the left side matches the padding on the right side
Padding on the top matches the padding on the bottom
All three columns have consistent spacing between them
Layout maintains equal padding across different terminal sizes
Visual appearance is balanced and symmetrical

userStories.title: Filter by project
userStories.description: As a user, I want to filter the Kanban board to show only user stories from specific projects so that I can focus on one project at a time.
acceptanceCriteria: A filter control or keyboard shortcut allows selecting a project
When a project is selected, only stories from that project are displayed
An 'All Projects' option shows stories from all discovered projects
Current filter selection is displayed in the UI
Filter persists during the session but resets on restart

userStories.title: Fast prd.json file discovery
userStories.description: As a user, I want prd.json files to be discovered quickly even in large directory trees so that the application starts fast and remains responsive.
acceptanceCriteria: File discovery completes within seconds even for large directories like ~/Developer
Common non-project directories are skipped (node_modules, .git, vendor, __pycache__, etc.)
Consider using fd or parallel directory walking for improved performance
Progress indicator shows scanning is in progress for large directories
Application remains responsive during file discovery

userStories.title: Fix logo padding and use isometric 3D ASCII style
userStories.description: As a user, I want the ASCII art logo to have proper top padding so it is not cut off, and I want it to use a clean isometric/3D style for a more distinctive and professional appearance.
acceptanceCriteria: Logo has sufficient top padding so no part is cut off
Logo uses a clean isometric/3D ASCII art style
Logo displays 'PRD Monitor' clearly
Logo remains centered and adapts to terminal width
Visual appearance is distinctive and professional

userStories.title: Smaller logo with top padding
userStories.description: As a user, I want the ASCII art logo to be smaller and have padding above it so that more space is available for the Kanban board content.
acceptanceCriteria: Logo is reduced in size while remaining legible
There is visible padding/spacing above the logo
Logo does not dominate the screen on smaller terminals
Overall layout feels more balanced with the smaller logo

userStories.title: Active project filter indicator
userStories.description: As a user, I want a visual indicator when a project filter is active so that I know I'm viewing a filtered subset of stories.
acceptanceCriteria: A clear indicator is displayed when a project filter is active
The indicator shows which project is currently being filtered
Indicator is visible in the header, status bar, or other prominent location
Indicator disappears when filter is cleared or set to 'All Projects'

userStories.title: Sort cards by date changed
userStories.description: As a user, I want cards in each column to be ordered by the date they were last changed so that the most recently updated stories appear at the top.
acceptanceCriteria: Cards are sorted by last modification date within each column
Most recently changed cards appear at the top of their column
Sorting updates automatically when prd.json files change
Date changed is tracked based on file modification time or story content changes

userStories.title: Card movement animation
userStories.description: As a user, I want a brief animation when a card moves between columns so that I can easily notice when a story's status has changed.
acceptanceCriteria: Cards animate briefly when moving to a different column
Animation is subtle but noticeable (e.g., highlight, flash, or slide effect)
Animation duration is short (under 1 second) to avoid disruption
Animation works for both status upgrades and downgrades

userStories.title: Use updatedAt field for completed column ordering
userStories.description: As a user, I want the completed column to order stories by their updatedAt field (if present in the JSON) so that the most recently completed stories appear at the top.
acceptanceCriteria: If a userStory has an updatedAt field, use it for sorting in the completed column
Most recently updated stories appear at the top of the completed column
Falls back to existing sorting behavior if updatedAt is not present
Sorting updates automatically when prd.json files change

userStories.title: Simplified file watching for large directories
userStories.description: As a user, I want PRDMonitor to start without warnings when scanning large directory trees like ~/Developer so that the startup experience is clean and efficient.
acceptanceCriteria: No warnings about directory watch limits when starting with large directories
Only existing prd.json files are watched for changes (not entire directory tree)
Startup message indicates restart is needed to detect new projects
Significantly reduced resource usage compared to recursive directory watching

userStories.title: Multi-select project filter with include/exclude mode
userStories.description: As a user, I want to filter the Kanban board by selecting multiple projects and choose whether to include or exclude them so that I have flexible control over what projects are displayed.
acceptanceCriteria: Filter overlay shows checkboxes next to each project for multi-select
Space key toggles project selection on/off
Tab key switches between 'include selected' and 'exclude selected' modes
Filter indicator shows count of selected projects or 'Excluding: X' in exclude mode
'c' key clears all selections to show all projects
No projects selected means all projects are shown

userStories.title: Filter selections not applied when closing filter overlay
userStories.description: As a user, I expect the board to update with my filter selections when I close the filter overlay, but it was only updating when pressing Enter, not when pressing Esc or 'f' to close.
acceptanceCriteria: Board rebuilds with filter applied when closing filter via Esc key
Board rebuilds with filter applied when closing filter via 'f' key toggle
Board rebuilds with filter applied when closing filter via Enter key
Filter selections are consistently applied regardless of how the overlay is closed

userStories.title: Cards show yellow animation highlight when closing filter overlay
userStories.description: As a user, I expect cards to appear normal when closing the filter overlay, but all cards were showing yellow borders (animation style) because the animation system was incorrectly triggered during filter operations.
acceptanceCriteria: No animation highlighting after closing the filter overlay
Split rebuildBoard into two methods: one for filter changes (no animations) and one for file changes (with animations)
Filter operations use rebuildBoard() which skips animations
File change operations use rebuildBoardWithAnimations() to highlight moved cards
Selection is cleared when filter closes so no card is highlighted
